t: Refactoring with AI: A Developer's Journey
s: A developer refactors a Python web app (Pipulate with FastHTML), tackling mixed concerns and inline CSS by leveraging AI and custom Python scripts to create a cleaner, more modular codebase.
sub: AI-assisted code refinement for CSS cleanup
Modularizing web app structure with plugins and roles
Balancing rapid prototyping with maintainable code
Custom XML-based context generation for AI prompts
